verdict.rationale: Hightouch publishes a public REST API with an OpenAPI 3.0 spec (36 paths, rendered reference). Its scope is explicitly limited to syncs, models, sources and destinations, while the UI also covers audiences, journeys, AI Decisioning agents, identity resolution and content. Git Sync and the official MCP server (audiences, journeys, syncs, ad creatives) widen programmatic reach, but nothing shows full UI parity through the API. Missing for 10: documented REST coverage of audiences, journeys, AI Decisioning, identity resolution and permissions; an explicit API-parity statement; independent hands-on corroboration.
